definitions.explanation: A theatrical performance or its script.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悲劇|ひげき}→悲劇：03577_higeki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{喜劇|きげき}→喜劇：11835_kigeki⟧
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{劇|げき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
examples.english: We performed a play at the school culture festival.

notes:
{劇|げき} refers to theatrical drama or plays.

AS STANDALONE NOUN:
{劇|げき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch a play), {劇|げき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧ (to perform).

COMMON COMPOUND TYPES:
- ⟦{悲劇|ひげき}→悲劇：03577_higeki⟧: tragedy
- ⟦{喜劇|きげき}→喜劇：11835_kigeki⟧: comedy
- ⟦{歌劇|かげき}→歌劇：13234_kageki⟧: opera
- ⟦{演劇|えんげき}→演劇：04106_engeki⟧: theatrical performance
- ⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧: theater company
- ⟦{劇場|げきじょう}→劇場：02714_gekijou⟧: theater (venue)

AS SUFFIX:
〜{劇|げき} indicates dramatic genres: ⟦{歴史劇|れきしげき}→歴史劇：27951_rekishigeki⟧ (historical drama).

RELATED: ⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧ is more colloquial for "play."
